notes: Reuse evidence (page-confirmed, not parent alone): the Ruud page lists the exact same six example serials as the Rheem page (W291013412; CB5D302F09 9903346; 7351 M28 06 16735; OR177 M28 07 00097; 08 04B10488; 1234518 72), with identical position descriptions for year, month, and week, the identical factory-letter note (typically F, M, G, W, or N), and the identical style images (Rheem-HVAC-style-1.jpg through style-6-1.jpg). The Rheem page lists many other related brands, but only Ruud is verified here as sharing this serial system; no other related brand is claimed as sharing it.
